summary: Rate-limit backfill during canary surge silently unpins long-lived keepalive sessions causing fallback to older model
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that during a scheduled canary window on 2026-03-09 we observed a spike in edge-side rate-limit backfill activity. Long-lived keepalive streams from Novum Analytics were silently losing their model pin and were routed to the legacy quantized variant (rw-open-7b-v1) despite an explicit tenant-level pin to rw-open-13b-v2-quant. Impact: degraded output quality and increased token cost for the customer; some streams produced responses inconsistent with pinned model tokenization.

Impact:
- 12 customer sessions observed to switch model mid-stream, resulting in degraded outputs for ~3% of requests during the 18:40–19:10 UTC window.
- Customer reports production user-facing quality regressions for conversational flows.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool for Novum Analytics in us-east-1 (reserved capacity).
- Canary rollout of rw-open-13b-v2-quant on 2026-03-09 18:00 UTC with small weight (5%).

Steps to reproduce (observed pattern):
1) Start long-lived keepalive stream to customer route pinned to rw-open-13b-v2-quant (tenant pin).
2) Simulate a canary traffic surge by increasing canary cohort traffic and triggering autoscaler preempt/scale events.
3) Observe edge rate-limit reconciliation/backfill processes (edge-proxy) when token buckets are refilled after burst.
4) Keepalive session receives a sequence of 429->retry->5xx responses; router attempts a backfill that omits the tenant pin header in the retry path.
5) Session TTL on session-store is refreshed but new affinity resolution lands on a prewarm instance still running rw-open-7b-v1, causing silent fallback mid-stream.

Expected behavior:
- Tenant pin must survive retries/backfills and keepalive handshake; retries must preserve pin headers/affinity attributes.

Actual behavior:
- Rate-limit backfill retry path strips or fails to copy pinning metadata (X-Model-Pin / affinity-cookie) in a race with autoscaler preempt events, causing the routing mesh to perform a normal selection and choose the legacy variant.

Logs & traces (excerpt):
- edge-proxy logs (us-east-1) show: 
  "2026-03-09T18:42:07Z ERR rate_limit backfill: missing pin header during retry for tenant=novum-42 request_id=7f4a..."
- router trace: 
  "route_decision: affinity_lookup: MISS -> fallback_select: rw-open-7b-v1 (available_prewarm)"
- session-store trace: "session-refresh: ttl updated but pin_meta absent after retry-attach"

Attachments:
- request/response sample batches, router traces, full edge log extract attached to ticket (s3://support-dumps/SUP-999550/).

Workaround (customer-facing):
- Support advised customer to reduce keepalive window to force new handshakes until fix deployed, and to temporarily widen canary traffic window to allow prewarm pool to converge.
investigation_notes: 03-10 09:20: Observed correlation between autoscaler preempt events and rate-limit backfill retries; preempt occasionally moves a pinned prewarm out-of-band.

03-10 11:05: Reproduced locally by simulating a canary surge and introducing artificial rate-limit 429s — confirmed that retry path omits X-Model-Pin header when retry originates from edge backfill flow.

03-11 14:30: Hypothesis: edge-proxy backfill handler reuses a lightweight retry client that doesn't copy custom headers when it triggers a fetch from routing service. Concurrency with autoscaler preempt causes affinity_missing path more often.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:02 - Marco Rivera (Support): Thanks for the report — assigned to infra-pinning subteam, adding autoscaler and edge-siglogs.
2026-03-10 12:14 - SRE (J. Park): Found edge retry client code that performs an internal redirect without header propagation under rate-limited backfill case. Adding trace points.
2026-03-11 09:05 - Eng (L. Gutierrez): Confirmed missing header in retry client. Preparing a small PR to copy pin/affinity metadata on retries. Will include unit test for header preservation.
2026-03-12 08:30 - Aisha Patel (Support): Customer accepted temporary workaround (shorten keepalive). Requested ETA for patch and CA steps.
root_cause: Edge backfill retry path did not preserve tenant pin/affinity metadata; race with autoscaler preempt caused affinity resolution to miss and fallback selection to pick a legacy prewarm instance.
resolution_plan: Patch edge-proxy retry client to preserve X-Model-Pin and affinity cookie on all retries/backfills; add e2e test for canary surge scenario; instrument router to log missing pin reasons. Target hotfix roll to staging 2026-03-13, prod 2026-03-15 behind a small canary (1%).
resolution_notes: Mitigation patch merged to main branch (PR #4121). Temporary customer workaround remains in place until hotfix completes canary. Confirmed no billing anomalies. Postmortem scheduled after prod rollout.
status_updates: 2026-03-11: Root cause identified; fix in progress.
2026-03-12: PR opened and under review (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4121). Staging test passed for header preservation.
2026-03-12: Customer notified of planned hotfix canary on 2026-03-15 and offered rollback contact.
resolution: In Progress — fix merged to main, canary rollout scheduled. Customer workaround provided.
follow_up_items: Add unit/integration tests to ensure pin headers survive retries and backfills (owner: edge team).
Add metric that reports pin-preservation failures per 10k retries (owner: observability).
Postmortem documenting timeline and customer impact (owner: Support/Eng).
